entry.name: jit.matrixset
entry.digest: A set of matrices for storage/resequencing
entry.description: The jit.matrixset object keeps a set of internal matrices which may be written to or read from. This may be useful for data storage and/or matrix resequencing.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Send a matrix out the left outlet.
messages.description: Sends a matrix out the left outlet.

messages.name: exportmovie
messages.digest: Export a matrix as a movie
messages.description: Exports a matrix as a movie. Themessage takes an optional argument to specify a file name. If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file.

messages.name: importmovie
messages.description: Imports a movie into the matrix set. If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file. Theandarguments may be used to set a time and index offset for the movie being imported (the default is 0 for both arguments). Theargument specifies the number of frames to import (the default is set to the value specified by theattribute). Note that the importmovie message will not resize the jit.matrixset.

messages.name: read
messages.description: Reads Jitter binary data files (.jxf) into a matrix set. If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file.

messages.name: write
messages.digest: Write matrix set as a Jitter binary data file (.jxf)
messages.description: Writes matrix set as a Jitter binary data file (.jxf). If no filename is specified, a file dialog will open to let you choose a file.
